dialogues.speaker: Udad
dialogues.text: A little. It's not a big problem, but I'm still stressed.

dialogues.speaker: Udad
dialogues.text: Like a few days ago, I heard some scholars in the tavern discussing something about a "grand conservator."

dialogues.speaker: Udad
dialogues.text: So I asked them how much conservation is grand conservation, and they didn't seem to understand what I was asking.

dialogues.speaker: Udad
dialogues.text: I'm a trustworthy battle-hardened veteran, yet the Parchamdar has to bail me out every time I try to talk to a scholar. It's pretty embarrassing...
